items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Lillen Strong played that once he came in.

ctx.x: I never knew it before my time.

That was a big place, right across from my, that big gambling place. Lillen Strong played that once he came in. He did too? Yeah. That, you know, called the Beverly Garden too. Oh yeah. The Beverly Garden. Beverly Garden.
Beverly Garden. Beverly Garden. Yeah, sure, I know where it is.
